task: Build and verify the Arcanea Genesis proof visual/system slice: generated proof relic, deterministic storybook seed, collectible blueprint, and /genesis UI integration.
surface: Genesis web-app tool surface, generated relic image, proof export metadata, and responsive desktop/mobile screenshots.
audience: Arcanea creators, internal world architects, and future marketplace/storybook operators who need proof, provenance, and rights gates before publication.
first_read: A creator call becomes a bounded Arcanea proof package with a premium visual relic, story seed, and explicit collectible readiness gate.

references.label: Arcanea brand pack
references.reason: Keeps the slice in AI-lab premium territory, with mythic materiality contained inside artifacts instead of product chrome.

references.label: Genesis roadmap and canon
references.reason: Prioritizes Genesis activation, proof metadata, public creator ownership, and Drift-as-condition framing.

references.label: Generated asset quality gate
references.reason: Requires inspection for fake text, artifacts, weak subject, and final-surface fit.

keep: Restrained AI-lab product chrome with mythic weight contained in the proof relic.
Creator ownership language and rights-review friction visible before any marketplace action.
Deterministic exports that can feed a world repo, storybook, and future registration pipeline.
avoid: Fantasy-game loot framing, fake scarcity, or cult mechanics.
Readable generated text, malformed marks, overblown neon, or one-note purple/blue gradients.
Any implication that public minting or sale is approved before source/model/cultural review.
direction.signature: The Genesis Proof Relic: a glass reliquary holding a source fragment and memory graph, paired with explicit rights-gated collectible metadata.
system: Palette: cosmic black, near-black glass, muted gold, manuscript cream, restrained teal, and deep oxblood accents.
Typography and UI: existing Arcanea Geist/product system, compact tool panels, proof chips, and 8px-radius cards.
Asset: generated cinematic bitmap used as an application image, not a final logo or public token proof.
Proof system: storybook pages, visual prompt record, collectible metadata, and rights checklist included in repo export.

artifacts.notes: Raw relic image inspected. Clear centered subject, no readable fake text, no watermark/logo, strong glass/gold/manuscript materiality, and premium proof-artifact read.
Desktop full-page screenshot inspected after resetting scroll to top. No nav overlap, no clipped text, proof relic and rights gate render correctly.
Mobile screenshot inspected. Stacked flow remains readable, controls fit, proof image and collectible/storybook sections render without clipping.
Proof system now exports storybook seed, visual canon, collectible metadata, rights checklist, and first-page/prompt records.

score.notes: First read 4/5; brand fit 5/5; craft/composition 4/5 due spacious desktop left column; accessibility/responsiveness 5/5; provenance/no AI artifacts 4/5 because generated image still needs final rights review before marketplace use; usefulness 5/5.

Repo-level security scan reported pre-existing leak findings that require separate triage before production promotion.
Generated relic is an application image for the Genesis surface, not a final identity mark or public token image.

decisions: Use /genesis as the strongest existing activation surface.
Keep mythic intensity inside the artifact and keep product UI restrained.

loop_phases.summary: Defined the proof relic, storybook seed, collectible metadata, and rights-gated export as the coherent system increment.
decisions: Reject raw NFT claims; require rights review before any mint/list/sale.
Use deterministic proof export files so future plugins/skills can consume the slice.

loop_phases.summary: Generated the proof relic image and implemented the Genesis proof/story/collectible system and UI.
decisions: Copy the generated image into apps/web/public/brand while preserving the source generated image.
Add storybook, visual prompt, collectible metadata, and rights checklist to the repo export.

loop_phases.summary: Critiqued the generated asset and responsive UI through direct image and screenshot inspection.
decisions: Accept the relic image as a strong application visual.
Keep desktop layout as a spacious two-column tool panel for this slice.

loop_phases.summary: Iterated the E2E selectors to match the expanded UI semantics and saved-record behavior.
decisions: Use accessible headings and scoped live-region/SIS-memory locators instead of loose text matches.

loop_phases.summary: Ran type/build/E2E gates, captured screenshots, verified server cleanup, and saved this evidence manifest.
decisions: Ship the local slice as a verified draft system, not a production marketplace launch.

tokens_used.type: Existing Arcanea Geist/Instrument Serif/Geist Mono stack.

generate_details.prompt_injected: Premium cinematic Arcanea Genesis Proof Relic hero/card image; dark glass studio reliquary holding luminous manuscript fragment, gold source seal, memory graph threads; no readable text, logos, watermarks, characters, weapons, skulls, neon, pixel art, or fantasy-game framing.
generate_details.inspection_notes: Direct inspection passed for clear subject, clean crop, no legible fake text, and brand-fit materiality.

suggested_fixes: Keep future Genesis visuals in proof/reliquary/source-material territory rather than heroic fantasy scenes.

flags: Generated manuscript marks are decorative only and must not be treated as readable canon text.
suggested_fixes: For public sale imagery, run one more asset pass with even cleaner blank manuscript geometry or vector overlay.

flags: Desktop left column is intentionally spacious and could be tightened in a broader Genesis UX pass.
suggested_fixes: Later iteration could bring the call controls higher for faster first-action ergonomics.

patterns_learned: Arcanea Genesis visuals work best when artifact-like, rights-aware, and evidence-driven instead of character-led.
Generated proof images should be paired with deterministic prompt, metadata, and rights-checklist exports.
failure_modes: Loose Playwright text selectors break when proof/story language intentionally appears in multiple regions.
Full-page screenshots after automated clicks can preserve fixed nav at a scrolled offset; reset scroll before visual QA.
successful_refs: Arcanea brand pack AI-lab premium direction.
OUTCOMES.md 30-point web/product UI and generated-image gates.

verdict.rationale: The verified local slice is ready as a private Genesis proof draft system. Marketplace publication remains explicitly blocked until rights review.

red_team_notes: Do not market this as mint-ready. Treat the collectible metadata as portable draft infrastructure only. Before production launch, triage repository secret-scan findings, run a fresh Vercel preview, and complete source/model/cultural rights review.
